control.desc: the unmutated control build: must survive

mutants.desc: 8 bpc red decode divides by 255 instead of 254
16 bpc green decode divides by 65535 instead of 65534
32 bpc horizontal motion read from the green channel
a 32 bpc hole mask value below 0.5 no longer counts as a hole
Vec Scale Y multiplies by the X scale
8 bpc hole mask loses its low bit
8 bpc size mismatch fill has alpha 127 instead of 128
16 bpc size mismatch fill has green 1
32 bpc size mismatch fill has alpha 1.0 instead of 0.5
Vectors Next is fetched one source frame late (single layer path)
Vectors Prev is fetched one source frame early (FG matte layers: the per layer plates path, load_layer_flows)
the forward flow is loaded from the Prev layer (single layer path)
Warping Inverse is served as Smart Blend warp code 1
In FPS is Out FPS reads the clip as 29.97 fps instead of 30
Src: Mark Segments 4 and 5 are swapped
frame to time conversion truncates instead of adding 0.5
Max Displace is read at time 0 instead of the current time
Vec Scale Y is read from the Vec Scale X slider

the 8 bpc per layer vector cap keeps the larger alpha (max for min): the composition matte no longer caps the vector alpha at 8 bpc (rewritten: the 0.95 matte step of the old m19 was replaced by the cap, fix 50)
flow inversion (one vector layer) keeps the sign of the x component
16.16 conversion truncates instead of rounding half away from zero
one vector layer present counts as no vector layer
the Source display is Display 3 instead of 2
the FG layer inverse matte shrink is not passed on (the plates path's exact choke of the cut gets 0)
the vectors-in layer job leaves the per layer plates path off (f5-vin Finding 1 undone)
the FG matte frames are read premultiplied by the matte layer's alpha (f5-vin Finding 2 undone)
the 16 bpc per layer vector cap keeps the larger alpha (max for min; f5-vin Finding 3, 16 bpc arm)
the 32 bpc per layer vector cap keeps the larger alpha (max for min; f5-vin Finding 3, float arm)
the engine's tap order (tap below first) in the border rows of the vertical passes of every pull-push fill and of the Weighted Blend blur (fixes 04 and 05, READ in round 3, undone)
